privacy.policy: Counts from one to four are banded before publication; actor identifiers and free-form player text are never published.

metrics.label: Authenticated human alpha players
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Distinct authenticated human actors in the 24-hour alpha evidence window
metrics.source: Production VaultFront playtest pulse joined to Obelisk-authenticated human actor evidence
metrics.unavailableReason: The public gameplay runtime and Obelisk identity integration are not live, so no qualifying production cohort exists.
metrics.interpretation: This is intentionally unavailable rather than zero: VaultFront has not opened a production alpha cohort.

metrics.label: Certified complete-loop players
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Players with one ordered Capture → Convoy → Pressure → Breach → decisive-delivery timeline
metrics.source: Production certified-loop evidence store, restricted to fresh server-certified timelines
metrics.unavailableReason: No production certified-match evidence store is available until isolated staging and production databases are provisioned.
metrics.interpretation: A launch claim requires at least one fresh, server-certified player timeline; simulated and test evidence is excluded.

metrics.label: Median decisive session length
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Minutes among certified matches ending in a decisive Breach delivery
metrics.source: Production certified-loop evidence store decisive-session cohort
metrics.unavailableReason: There are no production certified decisive-session samples from which to compute a median.
metrics.interpretation: Session length will be published only after a real qualifying cohort exists; an empty cohort is not reported as zero minutes.

metrics.label: Certified Breach deliveries
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Server-certified decisive VaultFront deliveries in production matches
metrics.source: Production certified-loop evidence store decisive-delivery records
metrics.unavailableReason: Production match evidence is not yet admitted, so test and staging deliveries are excluded.
metrics.interpretation: This will show whether the signature objective is actually completed in live play, not merely attempted in simulations.

metrics.label: Certified rematch intent rate
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Authenticated certified-match participants choosing rematch within the measured postmatch window
metrics.source: Production postmatch continuation receipts joined to certified match participants
metrics.unavailableReason: No qualifying production cohort exists from which to compute a privacy-safe rate.
metrics.interpretation: Once available, this rate will test whether the postmatch learning and progression reward earns another session.

metrics.label: Certified prediction calibration samples
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Privacy-safe player predictions resolved against server-certified match outcomes
metrics.source: Production Prediction League receipts joined to certified outcome records
metrics.unavailableReason: No production prediction/outcome cohort has been admitted; fixtures and simulations are excluded.
metrics.interpretation: This sample count will bound how much trust to place in published calibration and accuracy—not substitute volume for predictive quality.

definitions.authenticated_human_alpha_players: Distinct Obelisk-authenticated human actors observed in the qualifying 24-hour Alpha evidence window; bots, tests, and synthetic health checks are excluded.
definitions.certified_complete_loop_players: Distinct players whose server-certified timeline contains the ordered signature loop and a decisive delivery.
definitions.median_decisive_session_minutes: The median duration of certified matches ending in a decisive Breach delivery; non-decisive matches are not silently folded into the denominator.
definitions.certified_breach_deliveries: Count of decisive VaultFront deliveries admitted by the server certificate authority.
definitions.certified_rematch_intent_rate: Share of qualifying certified participants who choose the bounded postmatch rematch action; unavailable below the privacy threshold.
definitions.certified_prediction_calibration_samples: Predictions with both an admitted pre-outcome receipt and a later server-certified result available for calibration.
